# Quarterly Adaptive Tools Strategy Review

Date: 2024-04-13  
Attendees: Rhosyn Jorvham, Dorrit Peltdale, Saskia Silvhollow  

**Agenda:**  
- Review of mastery tracking enhancements roadmap  
- Teacher dashboard improvement updates  
- Official launch of the adaptive integration pilot  
- Next steps and ownership assignments  

**Discussion:**  
Rhosyn opened the meeting by presenting the updated roadmap for mastery tracking enhancements. The team reviewed the planned rollout of version 2.4, which includes a new adaptive assessment engine expected to increase accuracy of skill mastery identification by 18%, based on internal benchmark simulations. The projected release date remains June 15, 2024.

Dorrit shared progress on teacher dashboard improvements. The planned interface redesign will integrate real-time student progress alerts and customizable report widgets. Early usability tests with 12 pilot teachers at Maplewood District showed a 22% reduction in time spent navigating to key metrics. The updated dashboard version 3.1 is targeted for deployment on July 30, 2024.

Saskia announced that the adaptive integration pilot officially launched today, April 13, 2024. The pilot is focused on integrating mastery tracking data directly into the district procurement process to allow quicker resource allocation based on student needs. Saskia owns the pilot project and will coordinate with three participating districts—Eastbridge, Greystone, and Fairmont—to monitor progress. Early pilot goals include reducing textbook order turnaround by 25% and increasing adaptive resource utilization by 30% within the first quarter.

The team reviewed feedback loops to be established with district coordinators and teacher leads. They agreed on biweekly status meetings and a shared dashboard to track key pilot metrics including student engagement and teacher satisfaction.

**Decisions:**  
- Proceed with mastery tracking version 2.4 rollout as scheduled  
- Prioritize dashboard widget customization features for upcoming release  
- Formalize adaptive integration pilot reporting cadence with key stakeholders  

**Action Items:**  
- Saskia to circulate pilot kickoff communication to district partners by 04/16/2024  
- Rhosyn to update product specs with feedback from pilot kickoff by 04/20/2024  
- Dorrit to begin next phase of teacher dashboard usability testing by 04/25/2024
